title: BrauKunstHaus Zillertal Bier Zell am Ziller
highlights: Multimediale Ausstellung auf ueber 5000 Quadratmetern zur ueber 500-jaehrigen Brautradition
Faszinierende Einblicke in Rohstoffe, Brauprozesse und die Geschichte des aeltesten Privatbrauers Tirols
Interaktive Erlebnisstationen zu Tiroler Traditionen wie dem Gauder Fest
Stimmungsvolle Bierverkostung frisch gebrauter Spezialitaeten im BrauKunstHaus-Foyer
kurzbeschreibung: The BrauKunstHaus in Zell am Ziller offers a multimedia journey through 500 years of Tyrolean brewing history, topped off with a beer tasting.
beschreibung:
Over 500 Years of Tyrolean Brewing History

In Zell am Ziller, the BrauKunstHaus invites visitors on a sensory journey of discovery through Tyrol's oldest private brewery. Across more than 5,000 square meters, the modern exhibition unites traditional brewing artistry with innovative media technology.

From Alpine Spring Water to Beer Specialties

Visitors discover how award-winning beer specialties are brewed from the finest Zillertal spring water, local barley, and premium hops. The famous tradition of the Zillertal Gauder Fest is also vividly brought to life before the tour concludes with a tasting session.
